appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.help: Light, dark or the same as your system.

language.title: Language
language.help: For the app and for the names of new labels.

ai.title: AI engine
ai.keySaved: Key saved in the system keychain

claudeCode.name: Claude Code · your subscription
claudeCode.help: Uses your Claude subscription. Needs Claude Code installed and signed in on this computer.

anthropic.name: Claude API · Anthropic
anthropic.help: Pay per use with a key from the Claude Console. Senders and subjects are sent to Anthropic.

groq.name: Groq · fast, with a free tier
groq.help: Open models at high speed. Needs a key; senders and subjects are sent to Groq.

ollama.name: Ollama · 100% local
ollama.help: Nothing leaves this computer. Needs Ollama running and a model pulled, for example qwen3.

openAiCompatible.name: Other · OpenAI compatible
openAiCompatible.help: OpenRouter, LM Studio, vLLM or any OpenAI compatible service. Local addresses work without a key.

limit.title: Messages to review
limit.help: How many messages Ordo reads each time you organize or look for subscriptions. More messages means more senders and more time.

cleanup.title: Clean up
cleanup.help: Age already chosen on the Clean up screen.

protected.title: Protected labels
protected.help: Clean up never touches them. Protect them with the lock in Labels.

about.title: About
about.text: {{app}} v{{version}}. Your keys stay on this computer: the Google permission in the system keychain and credentials.json in the app folder.

update.available: Ordo {{version}} is ready: install it with the button at the top.
